content.text: {"regions": [{"id": "r2", "type": "stanza_note", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "Sl. 40. भङ्गुरवृत्तयः—evanescent or transient by nature. तैरेव", "end": "space"}, {"n": 2, "text": "चायं भवः—And wordly life ( is formed ) of them only. कृतम्—", "end": "space"}, {"n": 3, "text": "enough with. समाधीयताम्— fix in one place. कामोच्छित्तिवशे—which", "end": "space"}, {"n": 4, "text": "is (now) under control on account of desires being uprooted.", "end": "space"}, {"n": 5, "text": "स्वधामनि—in its own place or abode, viz. स्वयंप्रकाशे आत्मनि.", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r3", "type": "stanza_note", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "Sl. 41. तृणत्व०—of as little consequence as a small blade", "end": "space"}, {"n": 2, "text": "of grass. यस्मिन्महाशासने—V. l. Some such words as लब्धे or", "end": "space"}, {"n": 3, "text": "अधिगते सति should be taken as understood after this locative.", "end": "space"}, {"n": 4, "text": "महाशासने—&c.—The knowledge of Brahma as expounded in the", "end": "space"}, {"n": 5, "text": "Upanishads; the highest truth taught by them ( the four", "end": "space"}, {"n": 6, "text": "Mahávákyas especially ); Ràmarshi explains this by परमात्मज्ञाने", "end": "space"}, {"n": 7, "text": "( स्फुरिते सति ). Mr. Telang says—“It means whose commands", "end": "space"}, {"n": 8, "text": "are great; thus in the Upanishads एतस्य वा अक्षरस्य गार्गि प्रशासने", "end": "space"}, {"n": 9, "text": "सूर्याचन्द्रमसौ तिष्ठतः । or भीषाऽस्माद्वातः पवते &c.; the greatness consist-", "end": "hyphen"}, {"n": 10, "text": "ing in the great powers which obey those commands.” But", "end": "space"}, {"n": 11, "text": "Rámarshi’s sense seems to be more natural. The knowledge of", "end": "space"}, {"n": 12, "text": "Brahma is called Mahâs'âsana because it comes authoritatively", "end": "space"}, {"n": 13, "text": "from the Vedas, it being the highest truth taught by them.", "end": "space"}, {"n": 14, "text": "कोऽपि—indescribable. Cf. विकारः कोप्यन्तर्जडयति च तापं च कुरुते,", "end": "space"}, {"n": 15, "text": "Utt. नित्योदित—ever existing, steady, permanent. Cf. with", "end": "space"}, {"n": 16, "text": "this sl. 70 infra.; Gîta VI. 22.", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r4", "type": "stanza_note", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "Sl. 42. रम्या सा would be better for symmetry. सामन्त (सम्य-", "end": "hyphen"}, {"n": 2, "text": "गन्तः समन्तः border, frontier, तत्र भवः सामन्तः ) means a frontier", "end": "space"}, {"n": 3, "text": "king, a tributary prince. विदग्ध — a wise man. सापि राजपरिषद् v l.", "end": "space"}, {"n": 4, "text": "involves tautology since सामन्तचक्र has already occurred. उत्सिक्तः—", "end": "space"}, {"n": 5, "text": "swollen or puffed up with pride, proud. उद्रिक्त v. l. ( p p. of रिच्", "end": "space"}, {"n": 6, "text": "with उत् ) lit. exceeded, overflowed, hence haughty. निवह—a", "end": "space"}, {"n": 7, "text": "collection. स्मृतिपथमगात्—became a matter of memory i. e. history.", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": true, "note": "In line 7, the प in स्मृतिपथमगात् is only partially printed."}, {"id": "r5", "type": "stanza_note", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "Sl. 43. गृहे—used here in a double sense; (1) a house; (2) a", "end": "space"}, {"n": 2, "text": "square on a dice-board. तदनु बहवः—( And there are ) many after", "end": "space"}, {"n": 3, "text": "him, i. e. many who follow or depend upon him. The last two", "end": "space"}, {"n": 4, "text": "lines describe the game at dice in which the god of death and", "end": "space"}, {"n": 5, "text": "his wife (the male and female personifications of the principle of", "end": "space"}, {"n": 6, "text": "Destruction) are engaged. The world is their dice-board,", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r1", "type": "page_number", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "( 63. )", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}], "units": [{"id": "u1", "type": "notes", "number": null, "label": null, "open_start": true, "open_end": true, "children": ["u2", "u3", "u4", "u5"]}, {"id": "u2", "type": "stanza_note", "number": "40", "label": "Sl. 40.", "open_start": false, "open_end": false, "children": ["r2"]}, {"id": "u3", "type": "stanza_note", "number": "41", "label": "Sl. 41.", "open_start": false, "open_end": false, "children": ["r3"]}, {"id": "u4", "type": "stanza_note", "number": "42", "label": "Sl. 42.", "open_start": false, "open_end": false, "children": ["r4"]}, {"id": "u5", "type": "stanza_note", "number": "43", "label": "Sl. 43.", "open_start": false, "open_end": true, "children": ["r5"]}], "flows": [{"flow": "main", "units": ["u1"]}], "relations": []}
